euler.upside: A working lending protocol with roughly $238M deposited and $284M lent, worth only $19M as a token; a confirmed Crypto.com listing or a restart of the paused buybacks would be the trigger, but neither is dated.
euler.cheap: Lending tokens are out of favour, deposits are shrinking, buybacks stopped in April and the CEO left in January, so the market sees no reason for the token to capture value.
euler.wrongIf: Deposits fall under $200M on DefiLlama or no Crypto.com announcement appears by early December.
euler.vsScanner: The 'new Crypto.com listing' badge is unconfirmed (only an undated aggregator page), so I don't count it as a catalyst.

logicnet.upside: Subnet 35 now powers the liquidity side of 0xMarkets, a perpetuals exchange; a real mainnet launch of the exchange (vaguely 'late Q4') could restart interest.
logicnet.cheap: It already ran about 20x to Nov 12 and has crashed 95% since, so it's not ignored; it's a blown-off spike in a $125K token.
logicnet.wrongIf: The 0xMarkets exchange is not live on mainnet by end of December.
logicnet.vsScanner: Scanner calls it zombie from old code, but the subnet was repurposed and has a real story; still, the spike is over.
